name: Sun
defines: Your core identity — the self you are growing into, what gives you vitality, and the purpose you organise a life around.

aries.definition: Identity built on initiative. You come to know yourself through starting things, and your sense of being alive is tied to having something to push against.
aries.showsUp: You decide fast and apologise later, you would rather act imperfectly than wait, and you lose energy quickly in situations where nothing is happening.

taurus.definition: Identity built on steadiness. You know who you are through what you can hold onto — your body, your work, your comforts, the things you have built slowly.
taurus.showsUp: You take your time making up your mind and then barely move once it is made, and you are quietly unimpressed by urgency that has no substance behind it.

gemini.definition: Identity built on curiosity. You find yourself through language, questions and contact, and you become more yourself the more you have to think about.
gemini.showsUp: You talk your way into understanding, keep several interests running at once, and go flat in company where nobody is exchanging anything.

cancer.definition: Identity built on belonging. You know yourself through the people and places you care for, and your strength comes from having something worth protecting.
cancer.showsUp: You read the mood of a room before you speak, remember what matters to people, and retreat rather than argue when you feel unsafe.

leo.definition: Identity built on expression. You become most yourself when you are seen doing something you have put your whole heart into.
leo.showsUp: You are generous with warmth and attention, you take creative work personally, and you feel the absence of recognition more sharply than you admit.

virgo.definition: Identity built on usefulness. You know yourself by what you improve, and your self-respect is bound up with doing a thing properly.
virgo.showsUp: You notice the detail nobody else has, you would rather fix a problem than be thanked for it, and you are harder on yourself than on anyone around you.

libra.definition: Identity built in relation. You come to know yourself through others — in comparison, in partnership, in the balance you strike between your needs and theirs.
libra.showsUp: You weigh both sides instinctively, you find bluntness genuinely uncomfortable, and you can lose track of your own preference while accommodating someone else's.

scorpio.definition: Identity built on depth. You know yourself through what you have survived and what you refuse to look away from.
scorpio.showsUp: You give little away early, you see straight through performance, and you commit completely or not at all.

sagittarius.definition: Identity built on meaning. You become yourself by going further — into travel, study, belief, or any horizon that is not the one you were handed.
sagittarius.showsUp: You say the honest thing before you have considered how it lands, you need room to move, and you go restless when life narrows to routine.

capricorn.definition: Identity built on achievement. You know yourself through what you take responsibility for and what you can point to as built.
capricorn.showsUp: You are serious young and lighter later, you plan in years rather than weeks, and you struggle to rest without having earned it.

aquarius.definition: Identity built on independence. You know yourself by where you differ, and your sense of purpose comes from an idea larger than your own life.
aquarius.showsUp: You question the rule rather than follow it, you keep a certain distance even from people you love, and you are loyal to principles ahead of hierarchies.

pisces.definition: Identity built on permeability. You know yourself through what you absorb — atmospheres, music, other people's feelings — and through what you can imagine.
pisces.showsUp: You take on the mood of whoever you are with, you need solitude to find your own edges again, and you are drawn to whatever dissolves the ordinary.
